title: Asymptotics of Atomic Ionization Energy
exact_target: For the $N$-electron Coulomb ground-state energy $E(N,Z)$, determine the asymptotics of the ionization energy $\delta E(Z)=E(Z-1,Z)-E(Z,Z)$ as $Z\to\infty$.
